Subject: CAIQ assertion dossier and attachment queue

Hi team,

Acme (Northstar Financial's assessor) is asking for a compact CAIQ deliverable that combines our updated assertions with the primary supporting artifacts. They want a single "assertion dossier" they can hand to their control owners and then a separate queue of attachments they can request on-demand during sampling.

Goal: produce a concise CAIQ response set (CSV/annotated CAIQ) plus 1) control narratives for any non-trivial claims, and 2) a prioritized attachment queue (logs, diagrams, runbooks). They asked for an initial drop by EOD Thursday 6/10 so the assessor can triage ahead of interviews.

Immediate asks:
- Kimberly: can you prod the control narratives export from the mapping tracker and attach the first draft? Prioritize IAM, Data Residency, and Telemetry controls.
- Priya: please extract the representative runtime logs (one-week sample) and put a sanitized zip in the Drive link below.
- Marissa: coordinate doc ownership and confirm who signs the assertion cover note (internal attestation).

I've started a Dossier stub — attached as a minimal PDF that includes the assertion index and link placeholders. Use the Drive folder below for final drops.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bC-CAIQ-Dossier
HubSpot ticket: HS-12345

Thanks — let's keep replies short; if you can't meet Thursday, say when within 48 hours.

Elliot
Lead, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

I'll drop the doc in the Drive folder and add a short index in the dossier PDF. Priya — can you confirm the log sample cadence?

Hi Elliot/Kim,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying requests from the assessor side after a quick review:

1) For CCM/CCM.8 (Logging & Monitoring) we need to see the retention policy excerpt and an example of de-identified logs (the sample in the doc looks truncated). Can you provide a three-day sequence (UTC) and the retention policy snippet (policy id and effective date)?

2) For the encryption claim, please indicate whether key rotation is automated (yes/no) and point to the KMS attestation or HSM audit ticket if available.

3) Please provide the owner-contact matrix for controls mapped to engineering owners (so we can invite SMEs to the interviews).

We created a quick HubSpot activity on HS-12345 and uploaded an initial checklist into your Drive link. If possible, add the requested artifacts there. We'll sample a subset during our 6/14 interviews.

Thanks,
